correctness.rationale: Write one-trial law h=(A,B,C)=(1-p+pf0,pf1,pf2); its convolution-square coefficients are A²,2AB,B²+2AC,2BC,C². Direct independent symbolic expansion verified the three neighboring log-concavity defects A²(3B²-2AC), B⁴+4A²C², C²(3B²-2AC). As A,B>0 this is exactly 3B²>=2AC, i.e. the stated Xia-Lv inequality. Direct exact-rational replay of their support-0..3 example with p=20/23 and f=(1/20,1/5,3/10,9/20) reproduces equality in the condition but g4²-g3*g5=-1296/279841<0. This is a complete algebraic all-real proof, not extrapolation.

originality.rationale: Xia and Lv Proposition 4.6 proves necessity for general compound binomial, sufficiency for one Bernoulli trial, and gives n=2 counterexample with positive f3, but does not classify the full support-0..2 regime or establish that its counterexample is minimal jump size. The new n=2 iff follows by exact five-coefficient factorization, compared to the source in full relevant context.

value.rationale: A motivated sharp support boundary of the explicit failed sufficiency claim in the primary paper: for exactly two trials support <=2 is an exhaustive positive classification, while a real failure starts exactly at maximum jump 3; not an arbitrary tiny parameter substitution.

final_claim: For M~Bin(2,p), 0<p<1, and jump pmf (f0,f1,f2) with f1>0, its compound law is log-concave iff 3*(p/(1-p+pf0))*f1^2>=2*f2. The Xia-Lv positive-jump-at-3 two-trial counterexample makes maximum jump 3 the sharp minimal failure support.
limitations: p in (0,1), f1>0, support in 0..2, with endpoint f2=0 valid.
Finite rational sample is corroboration; the factorization proves all admissible real parameters.
